# LexTeam

> LexTeam (ЛексТим) is a team of attorneys in Skopje, North Macedonia. It provides legal services to companies and individuals in Macedonian, English and Albanian.

- Address: Bul. Ilinden 5/27, 1000 Skopje, North Macedonia
- Phone: +389 75 851 918
- Email: info@lexteam.mk
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=41.9990512,21.4280147
- Social: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/breshkovski.mk, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/ivan-breshkovski/, YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@breshkovski.law.macedonia
- Website: https://lexteam.mk/
- Languages: Macedonian (mk), English (en), Albanian (sq). Every page can be viewed in any of the three with ?lang=mk|en|sq.

## Attorneys
- Ivan Breshkovski (Иван Брешковски): attorney
- Neda Chalovska Dimovska (Неда Чаловска Димовска): attorney

## Practice areas
- [Civil litigation / Парнични постапки](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/parnichni-postapki.html): Representation in civil disputes: statements of claim and defence, hearings, mediation, appeals, revision and reopening of proceedings.
- [Administrative procedures / Управни постапки](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/upravni-postapki.html): Representation before ministries, agencies, cadastre and municipalities, appeals, administrative disputes, permits, public procurement and misdemeanours.
- [Commercial law / Трговско право](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/trgovsko-pravo.html): Company formation, Central Register changes, mergers and divisions, commercial disputes, liquidation, bankruptcy and industrial property.
- [Employment law / Работни односи](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/rabotni-odnosi.html): Employment contracts, internal rules, dismissals and disciplinary procedures, health and safety, work permits for foreign nationals and labour disputes.
- [Enforcement proceedings / Постапки за извршување](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/izvrshuvanje.html): Representation of creditors and debtors in enforcement proceedings: enforcement requests, objections, counter-enforcement and legal advice.
- [Family and inheritance law / Семејно и наследно право](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/semejno-i-nasledno-pravo.html): Divorce, division of property, custody and maintenance, paternity and maternity, legal capacity, probate, wills and lifelong maintenance contracts.
- [Criminal law / Кривично право](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/krivichno-pravo.html): Defence of suspects and defendants, representation of injured parties, criminal complaints, appeals, plea agreements and misdemeanour proceedings.
- [Property and construction law / Имотно и градежно право](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/imotno-pravo.html): Sale, gift and exchange of real estate, co-investment and construction contracts, building permits, cadastre registration and denationalisation.
- [Contracts / Договори](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/dogovori.html): Drafting, review and negotiation of contracts: sale, lease, loan, services, construction, co-investment, employment and SLAs.
- [Insurance / Осигурување](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/osiguruvanje.html): Advice on insurance contracts, damage claims against insurers, out-of-court settlement, court proceedings and recourse claims.
- [Human rights and media law / Човекови права и медиумско право](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/chovekovi-prava-i-mediumsko-pravo.html): Applications to the European Court of Human Rights and UN bodies, anti-discrimination, property rights, trial within a reasonable time and free expression.
- [Foreigners and residence permits / Странци и дозволи за престој](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/stranci-i-prestoj.html): Legal assistance for foreign nationals in obtaining and extending temporary residence permits for study, marriage or family reunification.
- [Other legal services / Останати правни услуги](https://lexteam.mk/oblasti/ostanati-pravni-uslugi.html): Oral and written legal advice, legal opinions and analyses, drafting of legal documents, mediation and arbitration, and personal data protection (GDPR).

- [Прирачник за безбедност на новинари](https://lexteam.mk/publikacii/prirachnik-za-bezbednost-na-novinari.html): AJM: Association of Journalists of Macedonia, 2024. Authors: Ivan Breshkovski, Toni Angelovski, Biljana Arsovska
- [Напади врз новинарите и медиумските работници 2017-2021 година: тенденции и препораки](https://lexteam.mk/publikacii/napadi-vrz-novinarite-i-mediumskite-rabotnici-2017-2021.html): AJM: Association of Journalists of Macedonia, 2022. Authors: Deniz Sulejman, Ivan Breshkovski
- [Род и различност во судството: Северна Македонија](https://lexteam.mk/publikacii/gender-and-diversity-in-the-judiciary-north-macedonia.html): OSCE Mission to Skopje, 2021. Authors: Kosana Beker, Neda Chalovska Dimovska
- [Индекс на безбедноста на новинарите на Западен Балкан: наративен извештај за Република Северна Македонија 2020](https://lexteam.mk/publikacii/indeks-na-bezbednosta-na-novinarite-na-zapaden-balkan.html): AJM: Association of Journalists of Macedonia, 2021. Authors: Milan Spirovski, Ivan Breshkovski, Marina Tuneva
- [Подобрување на безбедноста на новинарите преку измена на Кривичниот законик: анализа на меѓународни стандарди и домашна регулатива](https://lexteam.mk/publikacii/improving-the-safety-of-journalists-through-amending-the-penal-code-analyzing.html): Konrad Adenauer Stiftung North Macedonia, 2020. Authors: Kostadin Bogdanov, Ivan Breshkovski, Dragan Sekulovski
- [Прирачник за безбедност на новинарите при известување за настани од висок ризик](https://lexteam.mk/publikacii/guidebook-on-safety-of-journalists-while-reporting-during-critical-events.html): OSCE Mission to Skopje, 2018. Authors: Ivan Breshkovski, Spasenka Andonova, Toni Angelovski
- [Влијанието на законот за авторското право и сродните права врз работата на новинарите, фоторепортерите и медиумските работници](https://lexteam.mk/publikacii/the-effect-of-copyright-law-and-other-related-rights-in-the-work-of-journalists.html): Konrad Adenauer Stiftung North Macedonia, 2018. Authors: Ivan Breshkovski, Igor Markovski
- [Слободата на интернет во Македонија: извештај за 2017 година](https://lexteam.mk/publikacii/slobodata-na-internet-vo-makedonija-izveshtaj-za-2017.html): Metamorphosis Foundation, 2018. Authors: Dejan Georgievski, Ivan Breshkovski, Zharko Trajanoski, Ana Pepeljugoska, Valentin Pepeljugoski, Sanja Bozhovikj, Danche Danilovska, Elena Trifunovska, Aleksandar Nikolov, Dushko Todoroski, Vesna Radinovska
